Description

TNF released in the inflamed OA joint binds TNFR1 on nociceptors, which recruits the adaptors TRADD, TRAF2 and RIPK1. TRAF2 activates the kinase ASK1, which through MKK3 activates p38 MAP kinase, and p38 sensitises joint nociceptors to movement and enhances sodium currents. IL-1β binds IL1R1 with its accessory protein IL1RAP and also excites nociceptors through p38, which phosphorylates NaV1.8 and raises its current. Blocking IL-1 has not relieved OA pain in trials.

Colour

Each block is coloured by its effect on pain, red where it raises pain and blue where it relieves it, and everything in it takes that colour, GTP and GDP included, as it works for the block's result. Drugs are yellow and classes of molecules white.

This block is red: TNF and IL-1β sensitise nociceptors through p38.
